correctness.rationale: For every n>=3,t>0 the proof explicitly derives all CC, CL and LL inverse traces from a Dirichlet cycle Green kernel, Schur complements and a rank-one inverse update. Strict monotonicity forces maximum cyclic separation. An all-positive coefficient polynomial proves LL is inferior to CL, and the remaining difference is a linear expression of t with a unique positive zero. The full rational identities and 1797 direct grounded-matrix checks replayed successfully; finite results do not substitute for the uniform proof.

value.rationale: Choosing two perfect-reference sensors in a cycle with one private device per backbone node is a natural nontrivial control/sensor-placement problem. The parameter-dependent choice between backbone and pendant endpoints, a sharp closed-form threshold with asymptotic 6/n^2, all optimal placements, counts and objective values are a usable complete classification, not a routine restatement of the general leader-selection objective.
